night: Everyone, close your eyes. Our one night begins.
天黑了，请所有玩家闭眼。一夜狼人杀，现在开始。
ready: Check your secret role and read its instructions. Press ready when you understand.
请查看自己的身份和技能。阅读完毕后，请点击准备。
discussion: Everyone, open your eyes. Discuss what happened during the night. Your card may have changed. Do not look at your card again.
天亮了，请所有玩家睁眼。现在开始讨论。你的身份可能已经改变，请不要再次查看底牌。
voting: Time to vote. Choose another player. Everyone must vote before the results are revealed.
现在开始投票。请选择另一位玩家。所有人投票后，将揭晓结果。
results: The votes are in. Reveal the final cards and check who won.
投票结束。现在揭晓最终身份和胜负结果。
role-markReview: Everyone, open your eyes and privately read your mark on your phone. If you have Fear, stay asleep for the rest of the night. Confirm after reading, then wait for the closing announcement.
请所有玩家睁眼，私下查看手机上的印记。有恐惧标记的玩家，此后整夜请保持闭眼。读完后请确认，并等待闭眼播报。
role-lovers: Players with the mark of love, open your eyes and find each other.
拥有爱情印记的玩家，请睁眼，互相确认。
role-doppelganger: Doppelgänger, open your eyes. Copy a role and finish any immediate action on your screen. Later, follow your copied role unless your screen directs you to a separate copied-role call.
化身幽灵，请睁眼。复制身份，并完成屏幕提示的即时行动。之后跟随复制身份行动；若屏幕提示另有复制身份专属环节，请等待该环节。
role-werewolf: Werewolves, including Alpha and Mystic Wolves, open your eyes. Dream Wolf, keep your eyes closed; you do not need to use your phone. Awake wolves, follow your screen.
